Wyrm's Rock Fortress is a region in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3.

Overview

Wyrm's Isle foot

Wyrm's Rock Fortress stands on a rocky isle in the middle of the river Chionthar, taking up the whole space save for minor cliffs around. Wyrm's Rock Fortress is connected to the south to Wyrm's Crossing, and to the north to the Lower City by two drawbridges. As the legend goes, the isle once was home to a bronze dragon, who swore to defend the city from greatest dangers.

The southern side of the cliffs can be reached using spells like  Grant Flight or  Feather Fall and similar means, and explored. To the west, a series of jumps and climbing the Knotted Roots lead down to a small beach with a Dirt Mound and a Mousehole that might be used to open the path to the Wyrmway, or up the wall to a balcony behind the Audience Hall, allowing to bypass the First Floor of the Fortress. To the east, the path leads to a wall breach which can be used to gain access to the Wyrm's Rock Prison via its storage room. A rope ladder hanging from the cliff leads to another beach with a trapped Wooden Chest standing openly. Also, a small amount of alchemical ingredients can be gathered around the cliffs.

Making the way inside

Upon approaching Wyrm's Rock Fortress for the first time, the party finds out that the drawbridge leading inside has been lifted due to extreme safety measures: the ceremony of ordaining  Enver Gortash as the first Archduke of Baldur's Gate is about to start. The passage is guarded by several Flaming Fists, accompanied by three  Steel Watchers:  Fist Gai,  Fist Shah and  Blaze Elin. The latter is actually a commandant of the whole fortress, but she prefers to stand watch at the bridge in person, instead of tending to the stronghold's needs.

However, there are several ways to get past the guards:

  • Obtain an  Admission Pass to the coronation, wrested from  Arfur Gregorio or taken from the Nymph's Grotto in Sharess' Caress
  • Obtain the  Lower City Pass granted by  Investigator Valeria
  • Obtain the  Urgent Report for Duke Ravengard (found at the Sword Coast Couriers in Rivington)
  • Bribe  Blaze Elin (requires a  DC 25 Persuasion Check and 20,000  gold pieces)
  • Let  Wyll speak for the party as an Origin or as a party member (requires a  DC 30 Persuasion Check, and only works if he was not turned into a devil)
  • Several other options, based on the class of the player character (requires a  DC 30 Persuasion or Deception Check)

Alternatively, the party can walk around the patrol, by, for example, jumping down from the Wyrm's Crossing side onto the rocky footing of the fortress at X: 27 Y: 158.

Entering Wyrm's Rock Fortress for the first time earns following Inspirational Events, depending on the way that the party chose:

  • Convincing the Flaming Fist patrol to let the party in
    • ⁠Multipass ( Noble background) - if using Urgent Report for Duke Ravengard only
    • ⁠Rock-Solid Alibi ( Charlatan background) - for using any dialogue option to get in past the patrol
  • Getting in without a pass
    • ⁠Procedures be Damned ( Noble background) - this one includes the possibility of entering the fortress proper through the prison after being arrested
    • ⁠Through Nooks and Crannies ( Urchin background)

Behind the drawbridge is a tunnel which traverses the fortress to the Lower City, guarded by three more Steel Watchers and another Flaming Fist patrol ( Fist Larys and  Fist Serrik) at the far end. The drawbridge leading to the Lower City is guarded by another Steel Watcher and  Blaze Savora.

Layout of the fortress

Ground floor

The ground floor of the fortress consists of a vast tunnel joining two drawbridges, and two parts of the building itself, located at both sides of the tunnel. The tunnel is guarded by three Steel Watchers standing near each door.

Regardless of the way the party gain access into the fortress proper, as soon as they approach the nearest  Steel Watcher, an automated dialogue with it starts. The automaton informs the player character that their trespass will not be punished, after which Gortash himself connects to the Watcher and grants a personal invitation to his ordination.

To the right is the door to the first floor of the fortress, along with Mess Hall and stairs to the Audience Hall.

To the left are two doors, where Flaming Fists are quartered. The southern door leads into kind of a reception room. A Waypoint is on the northern wall, and there are stairs which lead to Wyrm's Rock Prison. The room is guarded by  Fist Callaway,  Fist Loudstone and  Fist Broko, as well as  Manip Cragbender and a Steel Watcher.

Quartermaster  Arkleia Oloril sits behind the counter. She can be convinced to show her stock of goods. Successfully convincing her earns the ⁠Nothing's Not for Sale for any character with  Charlatan background.

Also present are two groups of citizens waiting to be judged for transgressions.

The northern door opens into Flaming Fist barracks. The plaque near the barracks states it is for authorized personnel only, but nevertheless the door is not red-outlined. Inside  Manip Bakshi,  Fist Debin and  Fist Oriona are sleeping, while  Fist Reynash, who is meant to be on duty, is trying to lockpick Bakshi's chest. The party can choose to deal with Reynash or to wake other guards and resolve the situation with them.

Depending on party's choices, they might earn the following Inspirational Events:

  • ⁠Easing His Leave, and His Pockets ( Urchin background) - if intimidating / blackmailing the thief
  • ⁠Court Marshall ( Soldier background) - for turning in the thief

Basement

Main article: Wyrm's Rock Prison

The basement of the fortress consists solely of the Wyrm's Rock Prison, which can be accessed from the reception room through the spiral stairs at the far corner of the reception room, or from the outside via the wall breach at X: 42 Y: 190 (requires a  Perception check to detect). There the party can advance the ⁠Free Counsellor Florrick, speak with  Marvin the Unusual Skull[1] and also gain access to The Wyrmway, as a part of Wyll's ⁠companion quest.

Also, should a party member commit any transgression within Rivington, Wyrm's Crossing or Wyrm's Rock Fortress itself, they find themselves locked up in one of the cells of the said prison.

First floor

The first floor consists of the vast Mess Hall and the kitchen. Upon first visiting the fortress, the party can encounter several patriars' bodyguards and attendants in the mess hall waiting for their masters to descend. Discussing the Steel Watch with  Lord Amber's Bodyguard,  Lady Durinbold's Attendant and  Lord Shattershield's Attendant may result in approval changes with various companions.

In the centre is a door which leads to the Audience Hall on the second floor. It is guarded by  Fist Dresten and a Steel Watcher.

Also, if  Wyll is alive,  Mizora stands nearby the door to the Audience Hall. Upon approaching her, dialogue starts automatically. She prompts the party to attend the ceremony, and, if Wyll is present, mocks them about  Duke Ravengard's tadpoled condition. She dryly suggests that they speak to her again after returning from upstairs.

Second floor

The second floor consists of the audience hall and several adjacent balconies. No matter the time of their arrival, upon entering the Audience Hall for the first time, the party can witness the ordination of  Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate. Upon noticing the party, Gortash interrupts the procedure to have a chat with them. The dialogue itself differs depending on whether the player character is the  Dark Urge,  Karlach or  Wyll Origin, or if Wyll is a companion party member.

Within the dialogue, the party is offered an opportunity to strike an alliance with Gortash. The player character can agree to the proposition, decline it or choose a neutral course of action, while companions might have their own opinion on the subject. Also, at this point, the  Emperor chimes in, prompting the player character to agree. Regardless of their choice, Gortash tries to aim their efforts onto locating and killing  Orin by telling them about the shapeshifter spy in their camp.

In playing the  Dark Urge origin, the dialogue with Gortash sheds a fair amount of light on their pre-plot story and their personal participation in the whole of the conspiracy of the Dead Three.

After discussing the possible alliance, Gortash offers the player character to witness the ceremony. To this, they may answer using a variety of lines, the results of which can result in approval changes with various companions. However, choosing rude options – or trying to decline and leave – leads Gortash to cause pain to the player character for a few moments through illithid forces and thus makes them stay.

Lastly, the player character can react to Gortash's speech agressively and wage a fight. Doing so results in a confrontation with all Steel Watchers and Flaming Fists present (as well as the patriars' companions present, who run up the stairs to defend their masters [verify]).

After the cutscene with the ordaining ceremony ends, the party have a brief chance to speak directly to  Ulder Ravengard. Unfortunately, the Grand Duke is under the tight grip of his tadpole, and usually does nothing except sing praises to Gortash and conduct his ordination as the new Archduke of the city. However, if Wyll is present, certain conversation choices indicate his subjugation to the Absolute is not yet fully complete. Speaking to him about  Florrick does not shake off the Duke's delusion - but doing so starts a time-sensitive side quest ⁠Free Counsellor Florrick, if she was not freed previously.

This is the first chance to speak to Ravengard directly, and the last one if the party do not try (or succeed) to save him from the Iron Throne later. If the party descend from the Audience Hall without speaking to the Duke, they do not find him there again even if they return immediately.

The following Inspirational Events can be earned, depending on the choices made through the dialogue:

  • ⁠Coronation of the Dreadmaster ( Sage background) - witnessing the ceremony
  • ⁠Personal Invitation ( Entertainer background) - witnessing the ceremony
  • ⁠Shaking Bane's Hand ( Acolyte background) - agreeing to make an alliance with Gortash
  • Additionally, striking the alliance with Gortash lay the groundwork for gaining the ⁠Always Trust a Dishonest Person inspirational event for  Charlatan background, in case the player character chooses to betray the agreement later in their walkthrough (in case it was not acquired earlier)

Top floor

The top floor consists of Gortash's personal quarters, a vast roof area surrounding it (with several side towers), and a bell tower (also including an inner room and a climable area onto the roof).

After Gortash's ordination, he moves here and remains patiently until the party choose to confront him or fulfill their agreement, bringing him Ketheric's and Orin's Netherstones.

The top floor can be accessed multiple ways:

  • from inside - through the door in north-west corner of the Audience Hall
  • from outside - using scaffolds and ladders attached to the walls, as well as various means of spatial or enhanced movement:  Grant Flight,  Misty Step or  Dimension Door spells,  Potion of Glorious Vaulting and the like.

In the centre of the rooftop is a two-storied building, where the first level is Gortash's personal chambers, and the second is a bell tower (with a square gallery inside around the bell mechanism). Along the crenellations several ballistas are stationed, and at the bell tower roof stands a trebuchet. Both eastern and western sides of the rooftop offer a magnificent vista onto the river Chionthar and on the riverside part of the Lower City afar.

There also are multiple containers to be looted around the rooftop and also atop the bell tower for various kinds of uncommon, rare and very rare arrows and potions:

  • X: 23 Y: 184 - Heavy Chest
  • X: 22 Y: 184 - trapped Wooden Chest (accessible only via means of spatial movement)
  • X: 29 Y: 218 - Metal Trunk and Metal Crate near the blue tent
  • X: -26 Y: 200 - Wooden Crate
  • X: -12 Y: 203 - Wooden Chest
  • X: -1 Y: 208 - Heavy Chest (most upper ground, near the trebuchet)
  • X: 21 Y: 236 - the Thief's Stash (disguised as a pile of stone blocks; its location can be wrested out of  Reynash or requires an Investigation check to reveal otherwise)

The rooftop is guarded by several Steel Watchers walking back and forth, as well as being outfitted with several of Gortash's defensive inventions and Stunner Vents surrounding the Archduke's chambers. There are also three dead Bhaalists on the rooftop. One can be looted for  Assassin's Instructions, a note which reveals that these cultists were sent by Orin to haunt and murder Gortash. Seemingly, they were no match for the Steel Watchers stationed there.

Gortash's private chambers

There are a number of ways to enter the building: the party can use the main double doors in the southern wall, lockpick a side door in the western wall, climb up at the bell tower and use the doors there, or descend via a ladder from the bell tower roof.

Gortash chambers consist of his personal apartments and an antechamber. The antechamber features six busts of legendary leaders of Baldur's Gate. One of these busts depicts "The Cockeyed Stranger", as  Bane who first appeared before Enver Gortash [2]. At the eastern wall is a movable ladder which is initially raised to the upper gallery, but can be lowered via a lever up there.

After his ordination, Enver Gortash waits for the party at the far end of his apartment, guarded by  Black Gauntlet Numia,  Black Gauntlet Ulova,  Iron Consul Jaxbock,  Iron Consul Lo and another Steel Watcher. The room inside is equipped with many of Gortash's devices.

The course of the dialogue with Gortash depends on whether the player character has previously struck an alliance with him, whether they fulfilled the terms of agreement, and also on whether  Karlach is present. Confronting and killing Gortash without Karlach in the party brings a fair amount of disapproval  -20 from her.

Gortash's apartment has several chests (the locked one is opened with  Gortash's Key, looted or pickpocketed from him). Inside the  Helldusk Boots and the  Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves can be found. Also, behind the picture at X: -34 Y: 202 a wall safe is hidden ( DC 15 Perception Check to detect). It is opened with the same key and contains  High Security Vault nº5 Key and a unique  Elixir of Health. Two more chests with some minor amount of gold and valuables are at the upper gallery.

Also, a fair amount of books are on the conference table in the middle of the room, as well as at Gortash's desk and on a display box near it. In the safe is a copy of  Shield Steward Interrogation Log, which provide the party with some facts on how Gortash figured out the lurking presence of  The Emperor behind the Knights of the Shield leadership.

On the table in the antechamber lies a receipt for a full-height portrait of Bane. The portrait itself is upstairs, with a modest altar beneath. The God of Tyranny is depicted here exactly the same as he is portrayed on a mural in the final after-Epilogue cutscene with  Withers.

Wyrm's Rock traps

Gortash has outfitted Wyrm's Rock Fortress with a variety of traps. These traps only become active during combat.

  • Deranged Force Curtain
  • Grenade Impeller
  • Incineration Caster
  • Micromodron Force Curtain
  • Stunner Vents - in the pavement around the Top Floor

Notable items obtained in this location, whether looted, purchased, or obtained as a quest reward:

  • Elixir of Health - in Gortash's wall safe
  • Flame Enamelled Armour - in a chest at X: -28 Y: 184
  • Helldusk Boots - in a locked gilded chest at X: -32 Y: 219 on the top floor of the fortress
